published_implementation.historical_relation: preserved from the predecessor function-specific evidence record; no canonical organizational-function linkage is introduced by this migration

observations.disturbance: Multiple coding agents in the parallel CodeCRDT organization update one shared code artifact concurrently. Their useful local edits create interaction-specific integration variety, including the possibility of overlapping or semantically incompatible concurrent changes.
observations.coordination_relation: CodeCRDT supplies first-party observation-driven coordination over shared CRDT state: agents observe concurrent edits, incorporate the shared state and rely on strong eventual consistency to converge concurrent updates without a separate textual merge-resolution step.

reported_parallel_properties.semantic_conflicts: preliminary first-party estimate of 5-10%; requires reconciliation and is retained as a limitation

observations.comparison_limitation: The public evaluation compares sequential generation with CodeCRDT-coordinated parallel generation and does not include a matched uncoordinated-parallel arm. This observation is therefore descriptive direct evidence of the coordinated product boundary, not a causal estimate of CodeCRDT uplift versus no coordination.
